actor: Timur Suleimenov, First Deputy Chief of Staff of the President
summary: Says Kazakhstan will not be a tool to get around US and EU sanctions on Russia, but keeps its economic ties with Russia.
Says Kazakhstan has not joined the sanctions on Russia, but will not let companies use it to get around them.
Announces an online system to track goods that enter and leave the country, from 1 April 2023.
Says Kazakhstan will not let its territory be used to get around the sanctions, and that the goods-tracking system runs from 1 April 2023.

actor: Arman Shakkaliyev, Minister of Trade and Integration
summary: Says Kazakhstan fulfils its obligations to cut re-exports of dual-use goods to Russia, and that no company got around the sanctions in the last six months.
Says Kazakhstan has neither imposed nor joined sanctions on Russia, but does not want its territory used to get around them, to avoid secondary sanctions.
Reported: one-year export licensing for supplies to Russia, and tighter checks on goods from the EU, US and UK. No Kazakh legal act found.

actor: National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic
summary: After the US designation of Keremet Bank, says the banking sector is stable and banks work as usual.
source_type: news report (24.kg, relaying the National Bank)

summary: Banks tighten limits on transactions with Russia over fear of US secondary sanctions: slower processing, higher fees, some transfers stopped.
Calls the US and UK sanctions on Keremet Bank and Capital Bank unfounded and 'politicized', and appeals to the US and UK leaders.
source_type: news report (Times of Central Asia, relaying Kabar)

summary: Suspends the registration of 50 of 51 companies on a US and UK list of high-risk firms.

actor: Government commission and Central Bank of Uzbekistan
summary: Banks must warn clients about the risk of transactions with Russian banks under Western sanctions.
First reading of a law that lets the Central Bank set sanctions-risk rules for banks; the committee says it does not join sanctions on Russia.

actor: Otabek Tojiddinov, Central Bank of Uzbekistan
summary: After the EU sanctioned the settlement bank of Russia's Korona Pay, says transfers from Russia continue while banks move to a bank not under sanctions.
